title: objectql: a stored field's `expression` is computed on insert before the autonumber is issued, so an expression that reads the record number stores null (or its `has()` fallback) until a later update by id
body:
Ruled: 6335312761 · letter A · 2026-10-22T07:31Z

Filing gate **① a product defect with reach measured**. The defect was measured by the os-dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2230, which executes objectstack-ai/objectstack#24981 ruling `6308445871` (maintainer 「其他同意」): "a composite title that must round-trip through import is a stored computed field". The run was on HotCRM `main` `c8a7a704` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`), on the `@objectstack/verify` boot with the seed replay. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack `domain:engine` triage. The fix lands here. objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2230 carries `Blocked-by:` this card and resumes on the `@objectstack` release that carries the fix.

## The contract

`FieldSchema.expression` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1856` at `06cab4849`): "On any other (stored) field: computed by the engine from the row the write stores and stored … on every insert and every update by id".

A row the insert stores carries its issued record number. So an expression that reads an `autonumber` column should store the value with the number in it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Setup:** HotCRM's nine record titles switched locally from `Field.formula` to a stored `Field.text`, with the **same** `expression` (the shape the ruling prescribes). The change was not committed.
- **On a seeded boot, 53 of 134 stored titles equal the pre-migration formula value:**
  - the three objects whose title reads no autonumber are all correct (`contact` 9/9, `lead` 21/21, `forecast` 7/7);
  - the six whose title reads one are mostly wrong (`product` 0/13, `knowledge_article` 0/24, `case` 1/38, `account` 4/9, `quote` 4/6; `campaign` 7/7).
  - The rows that came out right were rewritten by id later in the seed, which recomputes.
- **Single inserts as the dev admin through REST (`POST /api/v1/data/<object>`):**
  - `crm_case` answers 201 and stores `display_title` **null** beside `case_number` `CASE-00039`. The expression is `record.case_number + " - " + record.subject`.
  - `crm_product` stores "Probe 2230 product" without `PRD-0014`. Its `has(record.product_code) ? … : record.name` fallback took the empty branch.
  - Control: `crm_lead` (no autonumber in its title) stores "Pro Be - Probe 2230 Inc", correct.
- **Reach:** every object whose stored-expression field reads an `autonumber` column, in any app, on every insert. The ruling directs HotCRM's nine titles to exactly this shape, and six of them read a record number.

## Seat review (source at `06cab4849`, unchanged on `origin/main` `688052e147`)

`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, insert path:
- `computeStoredExpressions` runs at `:15807` (before the hooks) and again at `:16410` ("after the hooks and the strips").
- `applyAutonumbers` issues the record number afterwards, at `:16466`. Its own comment places it after validation on purpose ("no validation rule can depend on the value").
- Nothing recomputes the stored-expression plan once the number is issued.
- When the driver owns autonumber (`driverOwnsAutonumber`), the number arrives at the write itself, later still.

**Direction (the reader's call):**
- Recompute the stored-expression plan for the fields whose expression reads an issued `autonumber`, after `applyAutonumbers` and before the row is written;
- or issue the number before the second stored-expression pass.
- Either way, the driver-owned path needs an answer too.
- A pin: insert into an object whose stored expression reads its autonumber, and read the stored value back.

## Dedupe

**Method:** every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint and refreshed with `since=2026-10-21`. Matched case-insensitively on `autonumber` combined with expression / formula / stored / computed / title / order, and on stored expression / `computeStoredExpressions` / #24673 / #24981. The search API is refused for this session.

**Results:**
- Related:
  - #24981 (the ruling that prescribes this shape);
  - #24690 and #24778 (closed: reporting a client value a stored expression replaces);
  - #25000 (open: refusing such a write under `strictReadonlyWrites`);
  - #25071 (open: the docs and lint that steer a composite title into a formula).
- None is about the insert order against autonumber. **New.**
